name: java: initializer blocks are not units; a field in an enum constant's body is a field of the constant

name: go: type set elements are not units; embedded generic fields are named by their type name
source: written for v5 from SPEC section 6.4: a `type_elem` (`~int | ~string`) is not in the Go table, so it is not a unit; an embedded field's name is symbol_text of its `type` field (a `generic_type`, without the `*`, which is a child of the field_declaration) cut before the first `[`, then the part after the last `.`: `G[int]` gives G, `*H[string]` gives H, `pkg.K[bool]` gives K; the field's range includes the `*`; expected values derived by hand from the fixture and the grammars' grammar.js and node-types.json; a script converted the chosen texts to byte offsets and lines

name: python: augmented assignments and assignments to several names in a class body are not units
